opportunities.title: 2027 Nuffield Farming Scholarships

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based researchers interested in farming, food, horticulture, forestry or any other countryside and ancillary industry.
opportunities.summary: Scholars are able to conduct their study tour anywhere in the world for a period of no less than 8 weeks to further their knowledge and understanding of their chosen study topic.

opportunities.title: 2027 Next-Gen Nuffield Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based young people aged 18-24 with a demonstrable interest in the dairy industry or regenerative agriculture.
opportunities.summary: The 30-day study programme will take place in June/July 2026 and aims to give young people the opportunity to develop their understanding of the industry while also building networks and future opportunities.
